scenes.title: A normal day
scenes.said: Every file arrives and every check passes. Nothing waits for anyone, and Control Posture v1 is published.

scenes.title: A warning, and what to do about it
scenes.said: The scanner starts writing its words in capitals. A learned check warns, and the day still goes out, marked. Each warning's More offers to mark it as expected, tell the source or open an incident.

scenes.title: A written check holds a file, and the file sent again fills it in
scenes.said: The MFA export arrives empty and its amount holds the day: readers keep Sun Feb 25. The vendor sends the file again overnight, and that version is published.

scenes.title: An anomaly that was real
scenes.said: A planned migration moves a third of the logging file to the cloud pipelines. A learned check holds the day, and it is published as is. The new level holds Wed Mar 6 again until the owner accepts it; Thu Mar 7 is judged at it.

scenes.title: An anomaly that was an issue, filled and then corrected
scenes.said: The backup export writes a third of its completed jobs as partial. A learned check holds the day, and Sunday's file is carried forward, marked as Sunday's. Two days later the corrected file arrives and replaces the fill.

scenes.title: Fills each way, and one file replaced
scenes.said: Thu Mar 21: the TLS file comes with its rows twice, and only that file is sent again. Sat Mar 23: the EDR file comes empty, and Sunday's is carried back. Wed Mar 27 is yours to decide: fill it from Wed Mar 20, the same weekday a week before, an estimate.

scenes.title: The business changes, and the ontology comes first
scenes.said: The control board adds a fifteenth control. The catalogue is a closed list, so the new entry stops at the gate and what it reaches waits. The flow's owner declares it with the board's reason, the security lead agrees five minutes later, and Thu Mar 28 goes out with it. Coverage is cut on that day by the change's own step, eight points down; the score isn't moved.

scenes.title: The join that lost its applications
scenes.said: HR drops a department without moving its teams, so their applications lose their owner chain. Silver's rules hold what reads the chain until HR sends the extract again that morning.

scenes.title: One cause behind two controls
scenes.said: A certificate authority's intermediate expires, and TLS and log forwarding fail for what it issued. The platforms' share of the failures names it.

scenes.title: A rule said ahead
scenes.said: On Fri Mar 22 a tighter band for a failing WAF is recorded for Mon Mar 25. For three days it is coming, and each of those days' heads says so. From Monday it is in force, and its own step moved nothing.
